DateMailed.name: Date Mailed
DateMailed.definition: Date of card when mailed to the cardholder.

MailingAddress.name: Mailing Address
MailingAddress.definition: Address where card was mailed to.

MailingAddressUnstructured.name: Mailing Address Unstructured
MailingAddressUnstructured.definition: Unstructured mailing address where card was mailed to.

MailedFromPostalCode.name: Mailed From Postal Code
MailedFromPostalCode.definition: Postal code where the card was mailed from.

ValidFrom.name: Valid From
ValidFrom.definition: Date of the beginning of validation of the card.

CardSecurityCode.name: Card Security Code
CardSecurityCode.definition: Indicates whether card provides a Card Security Code.

CardSecurityCapability.name: Card Security Capability
CardSecurityCapability.definition: Identifies the security capabilities of the card. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.
